instructions: Airlock is the ONLY sanctioned path to remote hosts: never run ssh/scp/sftp, aws ecs execute-command, or a project's bin/shell-style connection helper directly from Bash, and never reconstruct connection details from Capistrano configs, deploy scripts, or ~/.ssh/config — pick a target from list_targets instead. Use Airlock proactively while debugging a ticket whenever up-to-date staging or production data would help and a local database dump cannot provide it (live record state, counts, feature flags, recent events). Prefer read-only investigation. Every command is human-approved in a native overlay; a denial may carry feedback — adjust and resend.
